Done. Both `create` and `update` had the same `qty <= 0` check inline; I extracted it into a `_validate_qty(qty)` helper at the top of `orders.py`, and both functions now call it. Behavior is unchanged — same `ValueError('qty must be positive')` on invalid input.

Both tests pass (`2 passed`). One environment note: your default `python3` points at an unrelated venv without pytest, and Homebrew's pytest crashes on a broken globally-installed `web3` plugin, so I ran the suite with `PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -m pytest test_orders.py` — the failure there is in that plugin's import, not in this code.
